objective: Write the leaf pure modules of Lantern Express with their specs: LanternConfig (every GDD value, tiles, tracks, cars), LootRules (stops and critter rolls), CarryRules (carrying, loading, the fog) and WispRules (nights and the Lampeater).
acceptance_criteria: Signatures exactly as architecture 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5; every value equals GDD section C, F, H and decision 0018 section 5

LanternConfig.TILES has 8 tiles with 24 small and 8 big sites and building boxes; LanternConfig.TRACKS has the two 5,700-stud loops (stops at 700, 1,400, 2,100; radius >= 600 at night) and the two Dawn tracks; CARS total 78 studs with 12 seats (LanternConfig.spec)

LootRules: counts per GDD C6, deterministic builds, stop 1 crate on the 22-stud site, odds sums of 10,000 for every line, leg, tile and band, 100,000-roll frequencies within 0.5 points, Moon Hare only on leg 3 far crates (LootRules.spec)
CarryRules: one spec case per cell of the GDD J table, speeds 16 / 15 / 13 / 9 / 13, full bunker keeps coal carried, close loses every free and carried item (CarryRules.spec)

WispRules: wave sizes per GDD C6, the 7-degree cone edges, clampAim refusals, exposure across beams, puff times 0.6 / 0.45 / 0.35, aims sent faster never puff faster, Lampeater timing, shoo and fed (WispRules.spec)
lune run tests/run, selene, stylua --check, validate-tasks and check-scope pass; Purity.spec covers the four modules
verification: CI; A15 reviews the specs against the GDD tables
notes: LanternConfig.TILES is the contract LANTERN-009 models the tiles around: land it before the tile art starts. The track control points are authored here (architecture 3.1); TrackRules (LANTERN-004) measures them, so LanternConfig.spec's length and radius checks join LANTERN-004's run if TrackRules is not merged yet (a stub test is fine).
